contracts.title: Complete yellow submarine silhouette
invariants: The submarine remains one complete connected paper silhouette even where the neutral composition hides it behind seaweed.
The lower hull, tail fin, propeller, and periscope are present in the subject layer and are not borrowed from the front or rear layers.
Moving the foreground away exposes intentional submarine contours rather than clipped edges, painted-over gaps, or rear-ocean leakage.
requiredNegativeSpaces: clean exterior separation around the propeller
clean exterior separation between the periscope and the surrounding ocean
